scope: Container behavior and source provenance; not a general production release acceptance

security_scope.interpreter_advisory_coverage: The official image /usr/local CPython interpreter is not covered by pip-audit or Debian dpkg advisory matching

preliminary_os_scan.scope: installed OS packages; Python distributions audited separately

advisories.reason: mount binary exists and is setuid. Exact image fstab contains only an unconfigured comment. Qualified deployment runs UID10001 with no-new-privileges, cap-dropALL and read-only root; vulnerable authorized-fstab-user mount preconditions are absent. Do not extend this classification to privileged/custom-fstab deployments.
advisories.title: util-linux: TOCTOU in the mount program via ancestor directory swap on target path

advisories.reason: libblkid and blkid utility exist. Bundled HTTP routes do not probe untrusted disk/partition images; restricted container has no supplied block-device interface. Affected package remains installed.
advisories.title: util-linux: util-linux: Partition metadata compromise via integer overflow in DOS partition parser

advisories.reason: Same mount/fstab and privilege constraints as CVE-2026-53613; source binding/owner rewrite requires an authorized restricted bind-mount configuration that the image does not provide.
advisories.title: util-linux: util-linux: restricted bind mounts do not pin the source, allowing X-mount.owner/group/mode redirection

advisories.reason: GNU gzip utility exists. Vulnerability concerns its LZW-then-LZH multi-file CLI decoding. Bundled HTTP routes do not invoke it; Python gzip module uses core zlib and is distinct. Affected utility remains installed.
advisories.title: gzip: gzip: Information disclosure via global buffer overflow in LZH decompression

advisories.reason: libacl is installed. Bundled core/demo does not invoke pathname ACL management, and qualified container is non-root with no-new-privileges/cap-dropALL. This is an exposure limitation, not package remediation.
advisories.title: acl: Symlink traversal privilege escalation via libacl functions

advisories.reason: Exact image includes usr/bin/infocmp. Bundled HTTP service does not invoke infocmp or expose terminfo tooling; affected utility remains installed.
advisories.title: ncurses: ncurses: Buffer overflow vulnerability may lead to arbitrary code execution.

advisories.reason: Installed SQLite3.40.1 is in scanner affected range and CPython _sqlite3 extension exists. Bundled Bessemer/demo source has no SQL execution API. This is not a library-level unaffected claim; arbitrary SQL/SQLite application workloads need mitigation or updated library.
advisories.title: sqlite: SQLite integer overflow

advisories.reason: libsqlite3 contains ENABLE_FTS5 compiled-option string and CPython sqlite module is present. No bundled SQL/database-upload route exists, but untrusted database/FTS5 application use is not qualified.
advisories.title: sqlite: SQLite: Arbitrary code execution via crafted FTS5 full-text search data

advisories.reason: Same SQLite/FTS5 component evidence. Do not dismiss based on the framework not using SQLite; arbitrary application use needs separate mitigation.
advisories.title: sqlite: SQLite: Arbitrary code execution and crash via heap-based buffer overflow in FTS5

advisories.reason: Same SQLite/FTS5 component evidence. Bundled service has no SQL route; installed vulnerable component remains a release/deployment decision.
advisories.title: sqlite: sqlite: Denial of service via heap-based buffer overflow in FTS5

advisories.reason: Scanner maps systemd source advisory to libsystemd0/libudev1. No systemd-homed binary exists in the exact image and the service PID1 is Bessemer, so the homed-managed-user precondition is absent.
advisories.title: systemd: systemd-homed: Local privilege escalation via missing home-record signature verification

advisories.reason: Only minimal perl-base is installed; no Archive/Tar.pm file exists in image layers. Advisory concerns Archive::Tar Perl module, not the installed minimal interpreter itself.
advisories.title: perl-Archive-Tar: perl-Archive-Tar: Denial of Service via crafted tar header with large entry size

advisories.reason: CVE concerns contrib MiniZip zipOpenNewFileInZip4_64. No MiniZip package/path or pyminizip distribution exists in this exact image. Installed zlib1g file list contains only core libz; extracted libz has no zipOpen/unzOpen exports. Core zlib use is distinct from absent MiniZip code.
advisories.title: zlib: integer overflow and resultant heap-based buffer overflow in zipOpenNewFileInZip4_6

preliminary_static_triage.method: Static report/source/package inventory and exact image-layer file/symbol inspection; no exploit, crafted database, or vulnerable utility execution.
preliminary_static_triage.remaining_decision: Prefer updated supported base/library where possible; re-scan and re-qualify exact rebuilt image. Component absence can be carried only after checking new inventory/file identities. No suppression file or base change made.
preliminary_static_triage.scope: Manual component applicability/exposure triage; raw scanner findings retained; no all-image-clean or external application safety claim.

production_python_audit_provenance.scope: Metadata-only exact a2 inventory refresh. Existing reports cover unchanged external distribution versions; fresh scanner run deferred until quiet window ends. CPython and OS vulnerabilities are separate.

security_scope.python_audit_scope: pip and pinned optional Pydantic closure; local Bessemer covered by exact source/Cargo graph checks
